goal: Review all current Kibitz developer-tooling and documentation changes together, including the Codex-to-Antigravity harness, pinned reviewer model, workflow diagram, and implemented-versus-planned product boundaries.

acceptance.description: Only a complete review of the exact prepared base/head with all required checks passing can produce PASS.
Failures, unavailable authentication/tools, malformed output, stale source, and snapshot edits cannot produce PASS.
Review runs use independent copies, preserve the source repository, bound execution, and never merge or push.

The committed reviewer policy explicitly selects the owner-approved default model, records requested and CLI-reported model selection, and rejects missing or mismatched model evidence without automatic fallback.

All changed documentation and workflow diagrams agree with the executable workflow, distinguish implemented app behavior from planned redesign and historical verification, and preserve the owner's manual commit/push choice.
